# Omni Learning Anything
English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Deutsch · Português · Русский · العربية
**Download v4.2.0 Skill ZIP**
skills.sh · Installation channels
**Study a university course, a school textbook, or your own books and papers. Learn at your pace wit
h illustrated lessons, short checks and feedback.**
Turn “I want to learn…” into a plan you can follow. Start with a personal goal, a built-in course, a
textbook or your own materials. Review the plan before lessons begin.
Try **“I want to study the History of Chinese Architecture at Tsinghua.”** or **“I want to study Ope
nAI Applied AI Foundations.”** The agent identifies the source course, reuses what you already told
it, and asks only for details that affect your plan.
| Feature | What it does |
| Personal learning path | Turn a broad interest or specific goal into a course matched to your back

ground, purpose and time. |
| Built-in courses and references | Choose from 65 courses and two open

references. Keep the source edition, unit order and original workload visible. |
| Chinese school te
xtbooks | Search 1,949 entries from primary through senior secondary. Ask for the latest edition or
a specific year. When the index cannot verify the book, the agent checks the upstream repository and
searches online. Study a chapter, concept or formula with original figures and page references when

the textbook is available. |
| Your own materials | Study selected pages, chapters or timestamps in
PDF, DOCX, EPUB, PPTX, HTML, Markdown, TXT, SRT or VTT. Choose whether to include outside sources.

, EPUB, PPTX, HTML, Markdown, TXT, SRT or VTT. Choose whether to include outside sources. |

illustrations. |

al multilingual learning documents. |
| **v2.3–v2.6** | Ask for light checks, study your own sources

, review what needs attention and install or update more easily. |
| **v2** | Study in ten languages

, choose four local formats, or keep your course in connected documents. |
| **v1** | Approve a pers
onal plan and receive illustrated PDF lessons with practice and further reading. |
## Choose a built-in course
Ask **“show me built-in courses”**. Choose a course, your language and available time; the agent pro
poses a mapped plan for approval. These are independent learning pathways based on public course sou
rces. Complete lecture content is not bundled; no university endorsement or certificate is implied.

## Bring your own materials
Use PDF, TXT, Markdown, HTML, DOCX, EPUB, PPTX, SRT or VTT. Choose chapters, pages or timestamps and
whether outside supplements are allowed. Explanations and checks trace back to the selected source
locations. Legacy DOC and RTF need trusted conversion first.
A rough goal works too: “I want to learn a little economics.” The agent suggests useful directions,
explains its assumptions and asks only questions that affect the plan. A specific goal goes straight
assumptions and asks only questions that affect the plan. A specific goal goes straight to planning.
## Choose your learning language
**English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Deutsch · Português · Русский · العربية**
Plans and lessons support all ten languages listed above, independently of the source language or th
e language of this page. Arabic documents use right-to-left layout.
## Choose where to keep your course
| Destination | How it works |
| PDF · HTML · DOCX · Markdown | Choose a folder and PDF, HTML, DOCX or Markdown. HTML keeps its ill

ustration in one offline file; external source links need internet. |

end on your host, account and authorization. Support is checked for the current client; availability
on every platform is not assumed.
